_comment: bundler R28 (c): the committed third-party code no production lockfile names. Each source names the member (or bio-plane) that ships it, and either one package {ecosystem, name, version} or a lock file whose packages it lists (format cargo-lock: a Cargo.lock, its crates with no source left out; format pins: a pins file of vendored packages, {packages: [{package, version}]}). Read by thirdPartyInventory in release-advisories.mjs (R28, R29). A member's devDependency whose code is committed or bundled belongs here; a production dependency is read from the lockfile and does not.
